# opnsense_ndpproxy_settings (Resource)

Manages the built-in os-ndp-proxy-go singleton settings. Create adopts the existing plugin singleton. Routed endpoint deployments should disable proxy router advertisements and automatic host-route installation when Terraform already owns explicit /128 routes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `downstream` (Set of String) Logical OPNsense endpoint interfaces on which proxied neighbors are reachable.
- `upstream` (String) Logical OPNsense interface used as the provider-facing NDP upstream, normally `wan`.

### Optional

- `carp_depend_on` (Boolean) Run the proxy only while this router owns at least one CARP MASTER identity.
- `debug` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `install_host_routes` (Boolean) Whether the proxy learns and installs host routes. Keep false when Terraform owns static /128 routes.
- `proxy_router_advertisements` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
